title: Relationship Banking Schedule: the Share Credited Back on a Late Payment Fee
content:
The share credited back on a late payment fee billed to a card under Personal Credit Cards is read from the cardholder's Personal Checking relationship together with the card payments that have posted to that card account.

| What the records show | Credited share |
|---|---|
| An active Premier Checking or Private Client Checking account, and at least 5 card payments posted to this card account in the last six months | 65 percent |
| An active checking account whose tier is neither Premier Checking nor Private Client Checking, and at least 2 card payments posted to this card account in the last six months | 45 percent |
| Neither of those | no adjustment to the credited share is made |

**The two parts of each condition.** Each of the two tiers is satisfied only where both of its parts hold: the checking holding of the stated kind, active, and the count of card payments posted to this card account within the stated window. A cardholder holding an active Premier Checking account with 4 card payments in the last six months meets neither tier, since 4 is below 5 and the checking tier is not one of the other tiers; a cardholder holding an active Everyday Checking account with 5 card payments meets the second tier, since 5 is at least 2.

**On the boundaries.** The counts are read as at least: exactly 5 card payments in the last six months satisfies the first tier, and exactly 2 satisfies the second. A cardholder with 1 card payment in the last six months satisfies neither, whatever checking tier they hold. A cardholder holding no active checking account at all satisfies neither.
